name: Two-bar EQ swap
lesson:
## The whole handover in two bars

Same as the staggered blend, compressed to 8 beats: hi, mid, low of A leave in sequence while B's bass arrives, and A's fader is gone by bar 11. Peak-time technique for when the crowd will not wait 32 bars.

Both hands are busy at once: left on A's EQs, right on B's low and then A's fader. Practise the hand path with the clock stopped first.

tracks.cue: A on the acid bassline section, where the low band is everything.
Cue B at its groove intro with all EQ cut. Hi, mid, low of A leave in sequence over 8 beats while B's bass arrives; peak-time speed.
